results.summary: This design is a Tiny Tapeout graphics demo built around a small 4x4 ternary systolic array and a VGA generator. The array computes one of several tiny matrix demos selected by ui_in[1:0], with positive outputs shown in green, negative in red, and zero in blue. The 16 output values are rendered directly as a fullscreen 4x4 heatmap on a 640x480 VGA output. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform with the standard VGA PMOD pin mapping.
